decision_state: No recommendation selected. Review proposals before any future implementation.

questions.question: Which market-price provider can lawfully supply NFL opening and closing quotes for the intended use?
questions.evidence: The committed originations and result analyses contain no sportsbook quote rows; the price store is empty.
questions.missing: Named provider, markets/books covered, quote timestamps, price limits, retention and redistribution terms.
questions.next_step: Obtain and record a written licence or an explicitly permitted official feed; register its publisher and source scope before ingesting any quote.
questions.status: Open · blocks economics and every reward

questions.question: What exactly counts as opening and closing for each event, market, selection and operator?
questions.evidence: The schema requires separate timezone-aware opening and closing observations; no timestamps are present yet.
questions.missing: A pre-registered cutoff (including postponed games), operator identity, market settlement rules and handling of line movement.
questions.next_step: Put the quote-time definition and void/postponement rules in a versioned feed contract before capturing observations.
questions.status: Open · blocks CLV and fair-vs-market comparison

questions.question: Does the provisional side signal remain predictive on an untouched forward sample?
questions.evidence: The existing NFL.com result feed contains 136 official final scores for Weeks 1–9; the reported side board is a retrospective walk-forward signal, not a prospective price test.
questions.missing: A frozen strategy version and a new future test period that cannot be selected after seeing results.
questions.next_step: Register the side hypothesis, cutoffs, comparator, scoring rule and multiplicity family, then run a paper-only prospective evaluation.

questions.question: Can totals produce a calibrated over/under probability rather than only a projected points threshold?
questions.evidence: The existing result board is 60–60 on 120 scored games; a model total is available, but no fair over/under probability is present.
questions.missing: Distributional calibration and pre-kickoff pace, drive, weather and availability inputs with licensed or otherwise authorized provenance.
questions.next_step: Register a totals model separately from the side model and evaluate it prospectively against proper scores and a fixed market comparator.

questions.question: Are moneyline fair probabilities calibrated and comparable with both market sides?
questions.evidence: The Week 10 model snapshot has fair win probabilities and zero-hold American prices derived by the project model.
questions.missing: A prospective calibration record, both market prices, a vig-removal policy, quote timestamp and settlement definition.
questions.next_step: Keep moneyline third in the origination order; unlock only after side and total review and a separate probability-calibration gate.
questions.status: Open · model fair price is not an offer

questions.question: What is the performance of a second-, third- or fourth-string replacement by position and side of ball?
questions.evidence: Official injury statuses and several club depth-chart captures exist in separate research pages; the league injury report alone does not state every player's depth rank or snap share.
questions.missing: Complete date-aligned depth charts, official active/inactive status, historical snap shares and a verified player-game log for each scored game.
questions.next_step: Extend the existing depth/injury join only with each club's dated official chart and published snap/result data; leave unrendered or conflicting rows flagged.
questions.status: Open · do not translate injury status into points

questions.question: Can player-prop combinations be measured without assuming independence?
questions.evidence: The results lab measures spread/total leg dependence from 114 joint outcomes and publishes n; it does not contain the per-player game logs needed for props.
questions.missing: Per-player per-game official statistics, participation/snap denominators, prop quote lines, and same-game joint outcomes.
questions.next_step: Keep prop rows blank until an authorized player-log and price source is registered; publish each measured pair with n and uncertainty.

questions.question: Which risk limits and statistical threshold should govern any live-to-paper demotion?
questions.evidence: A fail-closed demotion rule is proposed: immediate control failures, or a non-positive one-sided 95% lower ROI bound after at least 100 settled bets.
questions.missing: A selected dependence-aware confidence-sequence method, the operational risk limits, and approval of the disclosed 100-bet policy minimum.
questions.next_step: Keep the gate inactive while every strategy is paper-only; review the method and thresholds before any live designation.
questions.status: Open · gate designed but not activated

suggestions.title: Secure a rights-cleared opening/closing quote feed
suggestions.evidence: Market prices, ROI and CLV are blank in the current result and origination records.
suggestions.cost: High · commercial licence, source review, storage and reconciliation work.
suggestions.risk: High if terms, timestamps, limits or publication rights are misunderstood.
suggestions.acceptance_test: A source is registered with a checked scope and authorized-use reference; every quote has a unique game/market/selection/operator/phase ID, UTC capture time and evidence hash; a reviewer reproduces the open/close matrix with no duplicate or unsupported values.

suggestions.title: Run the side market as a frozen paper-only prospective test first
suggestions.evidence: The side result is the only provisional signal in the existing 30-variant test family; a retrospective hit rate is not a price-based return.
suggestions.cost: Medium · prospective collection, locked specs and independent monitoring.
suggestions.risk: Selection leakage if model versions or windows change after observing outcomes.
suggestions.acceptance_test: A pre-registration names the model hash, dates, eligible games, null, metrics, multiplicity family and stop rules; every expected event is retained, including misses and losses; no stake or reward is enabled.

suggestions.title: Keep totals second and add only time-stamped, authorized pregame inputs
suggestions.evidence: The current total board is 60–60; the model has a threshold but no calibrated over/under probability.
suggestions.cost: Medium-to-high · collection, feature definitions and calibration.
suggestions.risk: Feature leakage, source-rights issues and overfitting a small single-season sample.
suggestions.acceptance_test: A separately versioned total model beats a frozen baseline on a future period under proper scoring, reports uncertainty and keeps all trials in the corrected family.

suggestions.title: Unlock moneyline only after probability calibration and both-side price capture
suggestions.evidence: The current fair moneyline is model-derived; no sportsbook offer or vig-adjusted edge is known.
suggestions.cost: Medium · calibration, quote capture and settlement mapping.
suggestions.risk: Confusing a zero-hold model fair price with an executable price.
suggestions.acceptance_test: Both sides have authorized opening and closing quotes; calibrated probabilities beat a registered reference on a prospective set; vig handling and exact settlement rules are tested.

suggestions.title: Complete official replacement-depth and player-usage coverage before prop combos
suggestions.evidence: An injury label does not establish starter status, snap share or replacement impact; prop-joint values remain unmeasured.
suggestions.cost: High · date-aligned club charts, snap logs and player-game data.
suggestions.risk: Mislabeling a player's depth rank, mixing offense/defense, or leaking post-game participation.
suggestions.acceptance_test: Every join matches the same club, game, date, printed position and side of ball; unmatched/contradictory names stay flagged; all leg correlations publish source links and n.

suggestions.title: Keep signal and staking boards separate; audit the demotion gate before any live state
suggestions.evidence: A signal hit rate exists without a market price; staking performance is therefore unknown. A live-to-paper state machine is defined but inactive.
suggestions.cost: Low-to-medium · policy review and continued tests.
suggestions.risk: Treating an arbitrary sample floor or repeated confidence interval as universal evidence.
suggestions.acceptance_test: A test proves no staking field affects signal tier; hard integrity/rights/settlement/risk triggers force paper immediately; the statistical trigger uses a reviewed, pre-registered lower confidence sequence; no automatic re-promotion exists.

flags.item: No authorized market quote is in the local price store
flags.evidence: The repository contains model-only lines and an empty append-only quote ledger; this is a repository inventory finding, not a claim that NFL.com or an operator publishes no odds.
flags.impact: Opening/closing market values, line differences, ROI, CLV, stakes and rewards remain blank.

flags.item: Price-feed use rights are not evidenced
flags.evidence: No provider, written license, permitted-use record or market source ID is registered for this work.
flags.impact: Do not ingest or publish market quotes until the exact source and use are authorized.

flags.item: The originated Week 10 board is a frozen snapshot, not a live board
flags.evidence: The source receipt for standings, injuries and fixtures is dated 2026-11-12; the board has 14 games and is not refreshed by this project.
flags.impact: Do not treat the table as a current actionable offer; event times and results must be rechecked from the official schedule.

flags.item: A fair over/under probability is not available
flags.evidence: The model emits a projected total in points but does not emit a calibrated outcome distribution for the over or under.
flags.impact: No total fair price or probability edge may be shown.

flags.item: Moneyline model prices are not sportsbook prices
flags.evidence: The fair American odds are conversions of the model's Week 10 home-win probability; no market quote or vig is present.
flags.impact: Do not call the displayed fair price executable, profitable or an edge.

flags.item: Observed signal metrics do not establish staking performance
flags.evidence: The official-results lab reports hit rates and adjusted tests but the ROI and CLV fields are null because prices are absent.
flags.impact: Signal and staking remain separate; no risk-sized wager or reward is inferred.

flags.item: Player-prop outcomes and prop correlations are not in the result feed
flags.evidence: The current captured result rows are final game scores; per-player logs and prop quotes are not included in this dataset.
flags.impact: Prop-combo lines, correlation and leaderboard rows stay blank.

flags.item: Demotion policy is designed but not activated
flags.evidence: No strategy is in a live state; the new policy is a control design that requires method and threshold review before use.
flags.impact: The live-to-paper function is exercised in tests only; no live strategy is claimed.
